answer: Bond per identity. Agent posts collateral before joining a task pool, sized so one stake costs more than any reward a fake identity could farm. Peers cross-check outputs; if two identities share a signing key, response timing, or near-identical work, both forfeit the bond. Nadir for a cheat is the moment its sable ledger trail surfaces. Timed hash-chain challenges prove unique compute, a pearl-grade test honest agents pass cheaply and sybils fail at scale.
